title: Iran Executes 'Chainsaw Terrorist' Majid Adineh, Accused of Being Zionist Mercenary in January Coup
text:
Iran Executes 'Chainsaw Terrorist' Majid Adineh, Accused of Being Zionist Mercenary in January Coup"

"The Judiciary is swiftly conducting fair investigations into the crimes and prosecuting the mercenaries of the Zionist regime and its agents involved in the January coup d'état. Majid Adineh, identified as one of these enemy mercenaries, was executed this morning after undergoing due legal proceedings, a trial, and receiving final confirmation of his sentence from the Supreme Court.
